how_to_apply: Open nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in and find the Google form link for the Medical Officer (MBBS) notification No. NHM/TVM/462/2026-D9.

Fill in the form with your qualification, TCMC / Kerala Medical Council registration and experience details exactly as they appear on your certificates. Incomplete or misleading entries can lead to rejection at any stage.
Submit the form before 5:00 PM on 17 October 2026. Do not post or deliver a hard copy; the notice says only online applications will be considered.
Take a printout of the submitted application and keep it safely.
Get a demand draft for Rs. 350 in favour of “DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM”, payable at Thiruvananthapuram, dated on or before 17 October 2026.
Watch your email and the two websites for the written test / interview and certificate verification schedule.
Bring the originals and carry copies of each. Claims made in the form must be backed by these documents.
Printout of the submitted online application
Permanent registration certificate from TCMC / Kerala Medical Council
Work experience certificate(s) from the employer, if claiming experience
The window is nine days from the notification date. Arrange the DD early; a DD dated after 17 October 2026 does not meet the condition even though it is submitted later.
All communication from the Society is by email. Use an address you check daily and enter it without errors.
If your experience is with a private hospital or an earlier NHM contract, get a formal experience certificate issued now; pay slips and appointment orders will be refused as proof.
No TA/DA is paid for the interview, and absence of any certificate at verification can remove you from the selection list.
Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Degree in Modern Medicine (MBBS) or an equivalent qualification. Permanent registration under the Travancore-Cochin Medical Council (TCMC) or the Kerala Medical Council. Provisional registration is not mentioned, so candidates still on provisional registration should not assume they qualify. Candidates must not be above 62 years as on 1 October 2026 . No relaxation is mentioned. The 62-year ceiling means recently retired doctors are within the age limit for this post. No minimum experience is prescribed as an eligibility condition, but experience counts in selection (see Selection Process). The notice is specific that only a work experience certificate is accepted as proof : copies of appointment letters, salary certificates or pay slips will not be accepted in its place.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 50,000 per month, consolidated. Nature of post: temporary, for the period the Mission is in operation. There is no claim to permanency and no labour claim against NHM, the Directorate of Health Services or the Government. Contract: the selected candidate signs a contract with DHFWS (Arogyakeralam) Thiruvananthapuram and is governed by NHM rules in force from time to time. Place of work: any institution in Thiruvananthapuram District, as decided by the Society. Candidates must be willing to accept this. The Society may prioritise interviews for different categories of posts based on requirement, and reserves the right to cancel, alter or modify the notification without notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on qualification, experience and performance in a written test and/or interview . The notice does not fix a date or venue; shortlisted candidates are informed by email, and the vacancies are described as immediate, so the schedule is likely to follow quickly after the closing date. Originals are checked at interview / certificate verification, and the Society can remove a candidate from the selection list at any stage if relevant certificates or records are missing.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies are there?
faq.answer: The notice does not give a number. It describes the vacancies as “Anticipated” and for immediate requirement in Thiruvananthapuram District.

faq.question: Q2. Can retired doctors apply?
faq.answer: Yes, if they were not above 62 years on 1 October 2026 and hold permanent registration under TCMC or the Kerala Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. Is permanent medical council registration compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice lists permanent registration under TCMC / Kerala Medical Council as a qualification alongside the MBBS degree.

faq.question: Q4. Can I send a printed application by post?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only through the online Google form on nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in. Hard copies are not required and will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. How do I pay the Rs. 350 fee?
faq.answer: By demand draft in favour of “DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM”, payable at Thiruvananthapuram, dated on or before 17 October 2026. The original DD is submitted at certificate verification, not with the online form.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification, experience and performance in a written test and/or interview. The date has not been announced; candidates will be informed by email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Rs. 50,000 per month, consolidated. No other allowances are mentioned.

faq.question: Q8. Will my pay slips or appointment letter count as experience proof?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that copies of appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in place of a work experience certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Where will I be posted?
faq.answer: In any institution in Thiruvananthapuram District, as decided by the District Health and Family Welfare Society. Willingness to work anywhere in the district is a condition of the post.
